useCase: Detecting GAN upsampling artefactos invisible to the human eye but present in dominio de frecuencia
mechanism: Computes the 2D Fast Fourier Transform and converts to polar coordinates to create a radial power spectral density profile. GAN-based upsampling operations (transposed convolution, pixel shuffle) create characteristic periodic ring patrones in the dominio de frecuencia that appear as peaks in the radial profile.
accuracy: Alta - 85-93% for GAN-generated images with upsampling artefactos
name: Detección de Patrón de Anillo de Fourier
source: Dzanic et al. (2020) - Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images, NeurIPS Workshop
parameters: FFT size: image dimensions, Radial bins: 256, Peak detección: scipy find_peaks, Min peak prominence: 2σ above mean
description: Detecta periodic ring patrones in 2D Fourier espectro caused by GAN upsampling operations. These spectral anomalías are invisible to human eyes but computationally detectable.

references.title: Dzanic, T. et al. (2020). Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images. NeurIPS Workshop.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.

strengths:
• Very reliable for GAN-based generators
• Detecta artefactos invisible to humans
• Mathematically well-founded
• Fast computation via FFT
limitations:
• Less effective for diffusion models
• compresión JPEG can mask spectral artefactos
• Small images reduce frequency resolución
• May produce falsos positivos on regularly textured images
